_why: UIV-B2 (docs/eras/uiv.md, machines 13-17, lines 30-33): the crust lift, the neutron drip separator, the neutronium cage, the r-process decompressor and the decay heat vault at RX J1856.5-3754, and the GTM steps of their lines. Figures marked tune in the contract are tuned here.

recipes.name: crust_lift
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 30: the tether lifts neutron-star crust through the polar-cap electrode; the tether wears (one in ten is spent) and the worn tether goes to the elevator's scrap row.

recipes.name: inner_crust
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 30: the crust is split at the neutron-drip line behind a Ni-58 supermirror guide (kept); the outer-crust ions go to the decay heat vault.

recipes.name: drip_neutrons
recipes._why: UIV-B2 lines 30 and 31: the inner crust boils its neutrons off (a fluid, never vented) and leaves the crust nuclei for the r-process decompressor.

recipes.name: neutron_superfluid
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 30: the drip neutrons are cooled in superfluid helium into a neutron superfluid; the neutrons that leak out decay to protium.

recipes.name: neutronium_pellet
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 30: the neutron superfluid is caged in a Ni-58 cage part inside the metallic-hydrogen coil; a neutronium pellet is never gtceu:neutronium.

recipes.name: hot_r_process_mix
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 31: crust nuclei swell in the drip neutrons into a hot r-process mix; the fission fragments go to the decay heat vault.

recipes.name: flash_target
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 32: a U-238 flash target in the same neutron flood leaves Es/Fm debris (it never makes Pu-244).

recipes.name: kilonova_decay
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 31: the vault is a local generator written final: 12,000 ticks at 33,554,432 EU/t into its own UIV dynamo hatch.

recipes.name: capsule_opening
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 31: the aged capsule is opened for its ash and a little helium-4 (the vault's trivial draw).

recipes.name: fragment_burn
recipes._why: UIV-B2 lines 30-31: the vault's inputs get a destination: the decompressor's fission fragments and the separator's outer-crust ions burn down to iron and helium-4.

recipes.name: mh_laminate
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 33: the BN-coated nanotube yarn is laminated with metallic-hydrogen foil.

recipes.name: mh_braid
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 33: four laminated yarns braid into the tether strand.

recipes.name: polar_cap_electrode
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 33: the metallic-hydrogen tether wound on iridium plates is the polar-cap electrode (kept by the crust lift).

recipes.name: crust_lift_tether
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 33: two metallic-hydrogen tethers and tungsten-carbide plates make the crust lift tether.

recipes.name: kilonova_capsule
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 31: the hot r-process mix sealed into a capsule for the decay heat vault.

recipes.name: es254_target
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 32: einsteinium dust pressed into a target wheel blank (the element 119 target).

recipes.name: uiv_field_generator
recipes._why: UIV-B2 line 30: the neutronium pellet is the heart of the UIV field generator.
